video_title: Get to Know Kevon Looney: Championship Pedigree, Anime, and MORE

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on Kobe Bryant's influence on his basketball career
quotes.excerpt: watching Kobe play and going in the backyard and emulating Kobe and trying everything that he used to do
quotes.quote: Some of my earliest memories of watching basketball was watching Kobe play and going in the backyard and emulating Kobe and trying everything that he used to do on the court. It influenced me to love the game of basketball.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney explains why he chose jersey number 55
quotes.excerpt: growing up one of my friends that passed gave me the number 5
quotes.quote: I chose 55 because growing up one of my friends that passed gave me the number 5 and he always wanted me to keep 5. Even when I was wanting to change it, I always had to keep 5 in my number, so 55 it is.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on his desire to emulate Kobe Bryant's playing style
quotes.excerpt: Kobe was my guy and he was somebody who competed on both ends and I wanted to be him
quotes.quote: Kobe was my guy and he was somebody who competed on both ends and I wanted to be him. I saw I played a little bit of everything. I brought the ball up the court, I could post up, I blocked shots. Whatever I needed to do to win, that's what I would do and that got me to the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on his role as a veteran mentor for younger players
quotes.excerpt: show them the way some of the things I learned from the veterans I played with
quotes.quote: Just kind of show them the way, some of the things I learned from the veterans I played with, some of the championship tendencies and knowledge that they gave me. Hopefully we can start this journey of winning one together. Also just learning from them. The NBA is always evolving, players are always changing, there's always new stuff coming into the league and I want to learn from them as well.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on what Lakers fans can expect from his play
quotes.excerpt: expect a lot from me, expect a lot of energy, a lot of hustle, a lot of rebounds
quotes.quote: Lakers fans can expect a lot from me. Expect a lot of energy, a lot of hustle, a lot of rebounds. That's something that I've been kind of known for. I want to bring that experience to the Lakers.
